snippet.title: Eki - The Station [Trailer]
snippet.description:
Eki - The Station is a retro-styled japanese inspired game about a person trying to get back home late in the night. 

Features: 
- Retro/PSX Styled visuals.
- Eerie japanese ambience.
- Five different endings.
- English/Spanish texts.
- About 3-5 minutes of gameplay per run.
- Jumpscares!

Made with Godot Engine.

Play for free on Itch!
